description: UI-004 new English for the CONTINUE? screen's gameplay hints (MM.BIN 0x7C584, 16 records; EXP-0080). Target: Sega Saturn MSHvSF (Japan), source image per references/mshvsf/saturn_jp/README.md. English only; each record names the Japanese source record by SHA-256 of its 76 bytes, which the build checks.
translator: Claude (AI), from the Saturn's own Japanese records rendered with its quote font (EXP-0080); not official text. No official English exists: the arcade sets hold only the Japanese hints, and the PS1 US has none.
policy: Joystick arrows keep the game's own glyphs as {XXXX} cells (0x01E2 up, 0x01E4 forward, 0x01E5 down-forward, 0x01E6 down, 0x01E7 down-back, 0x01E8 back). Buttons use LP/MP/HP and LK/MK/HK for the Japanese weak/medium/strong; PPP and KKK stay as written. Records 13 and 14 repeat records 2 and 9 and get the same English.

{01E2} to chase them and slam in a combo!
